focus_areas: Hair texture realism (strand definition vs. clumping)
Facial feature symmetry and structure via keypoint detection
Edge sharpness between wig and background
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the transition between the blue hair and the dark background. Does the hair look like individual fibers or a solid plastic mass? Also, evaluate the anatomical correctness of the doll's face, specifically the mouth and nose area, for signs of AI-induced warping using keypoint analysis.
image_description: A close-up shot of a doll or mannequin head wearing a voluminous, bright blue wig with straight bangs. The subject is also wearing a pink knitted hood or scarf around the neck and shoulders. The background is dark and indistinct.
